title: Compact finite pairing inversion with SHA-256 walk labels

claims.statement: The fully specified analytic classical algorithm in proof.md inverts the pairing for the exact supplied P with success at least 0.39 conditional on its sole joint SHA-512/SHA-256 random-function idealization. Complete cold work is below 2^(320583/2500) dense Fp12 reference equivalents at fixed C=20000: H<=K and R<=13344*K+2^90. Peak storage is below 2^50 bytes, advice zero, all preprocessing and failures charged. This is an exploratory heuristic bound, not a production execution.
